description: Replace manual PTY spawning with native Claude Code features: subagent definitions with worktree isolation, headless mode with stream-json, hooks for safety/quality, auto permission mode, /loop for monitoring, persistent memory per slot. The Tauri backend (Rust) drives Claude Code sessions programmatically instead of wrapping PTY processes.
goals: Replace PTY spawn in agent_lifecycle.rs with Claude Code headless mode
Generate .claude/agents/ files dynamically from chairman assignments
Parse stream-json output for structured events (text, tool calls, session_id)
Use auto permission mode — remove manual SafeExecutor SIGSTOP
Store session_id per slot for resume after crash
Route structured output to event_bus for real-time UI updates
non_goals: No Agent Teams — keep our own multi-slot dispatch system
No full Agent SDK rewrite — use CLI headless mode first
No cloud scheduled tasks for v1

user_stories.title: Subagent definition generator (Rust)
user_stories.description: New function in cockpit_brain.rs: generate_agent_definitions(project_path, cop, assignments) -> Vec<AgentDefinition>. For each chairman assignment, generates a .claude/agents/slot-{N}-{skill}.md file with YAML frontmatter: name, description (taskDescription), tools (scoped by role), model (from cost routing — opus for complex, sonnet for moderate, haiku for simple), permissionMode (auto), isolation (worktree), memory (project), background (true). Body contains: mission brief, assigned stories, coordination rules, commit conventions. Files written to {project_path}/.claude/agents/. Expose as Tauri command: generate_agent_definitions.

user_stories.title: Headless Claude Code launcher (Rust)
user_stories.description: Replace agent_lifecycle.rs spawn_agent() PTY path with headless Claude Code. New function: launch_headless_agent(slot_id, agent_name, prompt, worktree_path) -> Result<HeadlessSession>. Executes: `claude -p <prompt> --agent <agent_name> --output-format stream-json` with working_directory set to worktree. Spawn via std::process::Command with stdout piped. Parse stream-json line by line: {type: 'assistant', content: [...]}, {type: 'tool_use', name: '...', input: {...}}, {type: 'result', session_id: '...'}. Route parsed events to event_bus: agent_output for text, tool_call for tool use, session_complete with session_id. Store session_id in AgentSlot DB record (new field or use currentTask). Resume: `claude -p 'Continue' --resume <session_id> --output-format stream-json`.

user_stories.title: Hooks configuration generator (Rust)
user_stories.description: New function in cockpit_brain.rs: generate_hooks_config(project_path, cop) -> Result<()>. Writes .claude/settings.local.json with: 1) PreToolUse hook (command type): runs a script that checks for our 13 dangerous patterns (rm -rf, DROP TABLE, force push, etc). Exit 2 to block, exit 0 to allow. Script generated at .claude/hooks/safe-executor.sh. 2) PostToolUse hook on Edit|Write: trigger test runner if exists (cargo test / npm test / pytest). 3) Stop hook (prompt type): 'Have all assigned stories been implemented with passing tests? If not, list what remains.' Returns {decision: 'block', reason: '...'} to keep agent working. 4) SubagentStop hook: POST to localhost webhook that cockpit listens on for merge evaluation. Settings file uses .local.json to avoid git conflicts.

user_stories.title: CLAUDE.md and rules generation (Rust)
user_stories.description: New function: generate_project_context(project_path, cop, prd) -> Result<()>. Generates: 1) .claude/CLAUDE.md with: project name, tech stack (auto-detected), orchestration rules (commit prefix [slot-N], branch isolation, no cross-worktree changes), @prd.json import for PRD context, coding conventions. 2) .claude/rules/backend.md with paths: ['src/api/**', 'src/models/**', 'src/services/**'] — backend-specific instructions. 3) .claude/rules/frontend.md with paths: ['src/components/**', 'src/views/**'] — UI-specific instructions. 4) .claude/rules/testing.md with paths: ['tests/**', 'spec/**'] — test-specific instructions. Preserves existing CLAUDE.md if present (appends orchestration section).
tests: rules files have correct path scoping

user_stories.title: Stream-json event parser and router
user_stories.description: New module: stream_parser.rs. Parses Claude Code stream-json format (one JSON per line): {type: 'assistant', message: {content: [{type: 'text', text: '...'}]}}, {type: 'tool_use', id: '...', name: 'Edit', input: {file_path: '...'}}, {type: 'tool_result', tool_use_id: '...', content: '...'}, {type: 'message_stop', message: {session_id: '...'}}, {type: 'error', error: {message: '...'}}. Maps to XRoads events: TextChunk(slot_id, text) → event_bus::emit_agent_output, ToolCall(slot_id, tool, input) → event_bus::emit_log (shows what agent is doing), SessionComplete(slot_id, session_id) → store session_id + update slot status, Error(slot_id, message) → event_bus::emit_log + slot error status. Frontend receives these via existing Tauri event subscriptions.
tests: tool calls logged with tool name

user_stories.title: Persistent memory bridge
user_stories.description: Each subagent has memory: project. Claude Code auto-maintains .claude/agents/slot-{N}/MEMORY.md. Bridge to XRoads: 1) On session start, inject initial memories from our LearningRecord + PerformanceProfile into the subagent's MEMORY.md: 'This agent excels at backend_rust (94% success rate)', 'Struggled with TypeScript generics in previous session'. 2) After session ends, read the subagent's MEMORY.md and sync learnings back to our LearningRecord DB. 3) Intelligence panel reads MEMORY.md files directly for display. This creates a bidirectional bridge: our ML data → agent memory → agent learns → new data → our ML improves.

user_stories.title: Session resume via session_id
user_stories.description: AgentSlot gets new DB field: claude_session_id (String?, migration v18). On headless launch, stream-json output contains session_id on message_stop event. Store it. On app restart: detect non-closed slots with claude_session_id. Launch: `claude -p 'Continue where you left off. Check progress.txt and resume.' --resume <session_id> --output-format stream-json`. If session expired (error on resume), fall back to fresh launch with previous progress from AGENT.md + progress.txt. UI: recovery dialog shows 'Resume session?' with slot details.

user_stories.title: Frontend: structured output display
user_stories.description: Update SlotTerminal.tsx and DashboardMetrics.tsx to handle structured events from stream-json (vs raw PTY text). New event types on event_bus: 'agent-text' (text output), 'agent-tool-call' (tool name + file path), 'agent-tool-result' (success/failure), 'agent-thinking' (reasoning). Terminal slot view shows: text output normally, tool calls as colored badges ([Edit] src/api/auth.rs), thinking as dimmed italic. DashboardMetrics shows: active tool calls count, files modified count (from Edit events), tests run count (from Bash events containing 'test'). CockpitPanel slots tab shows: last tool call per slot, current file being edited.
